title: Tamil Nadu Cultural Heritage

S.subject: A vibrant celebration of Tamil Nadu culture featuring Jallikattu (traditional bull-taming sport), Bharatanatyam dancer, authentic Tamil vegetarian food, a majestic South Indian temple, and people wearing traditional Tamil attire such as veshti, saree and pavadai.

C.composition: Wide cinematic documentary composition with multiple cultural elements naturally connected in one scene. Place the Bharatanatyam dancer as a strong foreground subject, the Jallikattu scene in the middle distance, the temple rising majestically in the background, and a traditional food spread and kolam details framing the lower foreground.
C.camera_view: Professional photographer viewpoint, eye-level perspective with a slightly wide-angle lens.
C.framing: Balanced SCALE-style frame with strong foreground, middle-ground and background depth; visually rich but not overcrowded.
C.depth: Natural depth of field with the main cultural subjects sharply detailed and the background softly separated.

A.action: The Bharatanatyam dancer performs a graceful pose while Jallikattu participants and a decorated bull create energy in the background. Families in traditional clothing enjoy authentic Tamil food near the temple during a colorful cultural celebration.
A.motion: Dynamic yet realistic documentary movement, capturing flowing sarees, expressive Bharatanatyam gestures and the energetic atmosphere of Jallikattu.

L.location: Traditional Tamil Nadu village festival setting with a magnificent Dravidian-style temple, temple gopuram, decorated streets, kolam patterns and festive surroundings.
L.environment: Authentic rural Tamil Nadu atmosphere during a cultural festival, warm sunlight, traditional architecture and natural village details.

E.lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight with cinematic natural lighting
E.color: Rich, vibrant and authentic Tamil Nadu festival colors
E.details: Highly detailed faces, fabrics, jewellery, food textures, temple carvings and bull decorations
E.mood: Proud, joyful, energetic, elegant and deeply rooted in Tamil heritage
E.quality: Photorealistic, cinematic, high dynamic range, realistic skin tones, natural textures, premium editorial photography

final_prompt: Create a breathtaking photorealistic documentary photograph celebrating Tamil Nadu culture: Jallikattu, Bharatanatyam, authentic Tamil food, magnificent Dravidian temple architecture, traditional Tamil clothing, kolam and village festival life. Capture it from the perspective of a professional photographer using a cinematic wide-angle composition, strong foreground-middle-ground-background depth, warm golden-hour light, vibrant but authentic colors, natural human expressions, rich cultural details and premium editorial photography quality.
